title: Dependency Stall Classification
description: LLM 判读 batch timeout 真因的输出契约 (设计: tasks/ut/docs/designs/2026-06-23-pytest-timeout-redesign.md §5.1)

classification.description: dep_stall=依赖资源未就绪 (HF/pip 卡住等); not_dep_stall=代码/资源/网络断开; unknown=看不清，保守归 ignored

evidence.description: log 末尾原文引用一行作为依据（不允许编造或泛述）

dependency_hint.description: dep_stall 时给出具体资源名 (model id / pip pkg)；非 dep_stall 时为 null
